name: @metorial/appcues
description: Manage Appcues in-app experiences, including web flows, Flow 2.0, pins, banners, launchpads, checklists, mobile experiences, NPS surveys, and embeds. Read experience details and publish or unpublish experiences. Read, update, and delete end-user profiles; track custom events and retrieve event history. Read and update group profiles and associate users with groups. Create, inspect, update, and delete user segments; manage segment membership and initiate event or membership exports. Discover recent asynchronous jobs and inspect their progress.
